ideas.title: Local shop review-reply desk
ideas.one_liner: Independent shop owners pay a flat monthly fee to get every Google and Yelp review answered within a day.

cost_breakdown.item: First month of a mail tool

steps: Pick one street with 5+ independent shops
Write 10 review reply templates
Print 5 intro letters with a free sample reply
Walk in on a Tuesday morning
Offer $49/month for up to 15 replies, first month free
Deliver replies by email within 24 hours
Ask client #1 for two introductions
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Sell answered reviews, not writing tools
Cap at 25 shops until templates are proven
Check local rules on soliciting businesses in person
ideas.compliance_note: US: check local business-name registration and sales-tax rules.
